name: Google AI
description: Google's Gemini API for the Generated Image: the AI Studio key and the models it may use, shared by the Google Text and Google Image parts.

credit.text: Text and pictures generated by Google's Gemini models

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: A Google AI Studio key: create one in AI Studio (it starts with AQ.; an older AIza key is not accepted). Test asks Google which image models it may use.

properties.name: modelsCacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Model List
properties.description: How long the list of models Google lets the key use is kept for the forms and tasks. A new or retired model shows up after this. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: discoveryCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Google's API Description
properties.description: How long Google's description of its API (the picture shapes and sizes it takes) is kept. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (an old key's model list) is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: monthlyQuota
properties.title: Monthly Quota
properties.description: The calls your Google AI plan allows in a month. Only you know it, and the service is not asked. The System page's API usage card shows this period's calls against it, with a warning from 80%. Once it is used, the source stops calling and uses what it kept until the period resets. Empty: no limit.

properties.name: quotaResetDay
properties.title: Quota Resets On
properties.description: The day of the month your plan starts counting again (1 to 28), in the device's time zone. The period the bar shows starts on that day.
